reason: The caps seem intended to close the liner’s working windows and protect the surrounding ice. It is also the only available combination.
expectation: I expect the liner to be sealed for storage, though I’m unsure whether that completes the chapter.

effect: The caps closed the discovery case and completed the chapter’s storage goal.
reaction: It was reassuring to secure the surrounding ice, though the result offered little detail beyond completion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the liner windows was worthwhile because it secured the body with its surrounding ice after Earth’s request to bring the context too.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sole action was straightforward and its result was brief, leaving little to explore in this chapter.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the caps seemed intended for the working windows.

arbitrary.text: The action had a clear purpose, although it was the only available combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the frozen discovery reaches Earth and what is learned from it, although this chapter alone offered little gameplay choice.
